sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Manoj Kumar Tiwari Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of this bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
126 of 2022 at Police Station Gabhana, District Aligarh under Sections 498A, 307 I.P.C. and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in jail since 15.09.2022.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by learned trial court on 15.09.2022.

The following arguments made by Shri Manoj Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Chandan Agrawal, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
(1) The F.I.R. arises out of a matrimonial dispute.

Megh Singh vs State Of U.P. on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83044046/
1 (2).

entities.text: Megh Singh vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Delay of two months in lodgement of the F.I.R. in the facts and circumstances of this case is fatal to the prosecution case.
(3). The applicant is father-in-law of the victim.
(4). The applicant resides separately from the victim and her husband.
(5). The applicant never interfered in the matrimonial life of the victim and her husband and never harassed the deceased nor did he demand dowry.
(6). As per the prosecution case, the victim had set herself on fire after pouring diesel.
(7). The applicant was nominated in the statement of the victim in which she nominated all members of the family as accused.
(9). As per the medical report, the alleged date and time of the injury was 08:00 PM on 02.02.2022.
However, the date and time of medical examination was at 11:00 AM on 19.04.2022.
(10). Medical report cannot be related to the alleged incident.
(8). Material contradictions in the F.I.R. and the statement of the victim discredit the prosecution case.
(11). The applicant was nominated only to harass and humiliate the family of her estranged husband and leverage the criminal case in the matrimonial dispute.

(12). The applicant claims congruency in role and seeks parity in relief granted to the co-accused who has been enlarged on bail by this Court by order dated 12.01.2023 in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 57031 of 2022.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 57031 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: (13). The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
(14). The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Megh Singh be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.
The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
